notes.title: New Update! - Added the ability to disable player generated lists for Round 2!
notes.notes:
- Added the settings to disable player generated lists for Round 2! With this setting turned on, players will no longer be asked to enter words for Round 2. This is especially useful for streamers. Find the new "Round 2 Words" setting under "Main Settings" 
 - Opening the settings menu will now pause all timers

notes.title: JULY DEMO UPDATE! - v0.7.6 - Observer mode! Pre-results screen!
notes.notes:
Howdy folks! We're pushing one last major update to the DEMO with some new features before our full launch in August!

[list]
[*] Bug fixes! We fixed a number of bugs involving booting players
[*] Pre-Results screen! We've added a screen after final deliberation showing how the votes were cast and how the winner is decided. This will help make it more clear who wins and why
[*] Observer mode! Players that join the game after the maximum number of players (or in the middle of a game) will become "Observers". Their votes will be displayed during the deliberation stage, and can help sway the vote! However, their votes will not be counted towards the final score
[*] The deliberation screen has been updated to no longer show the clue list
[*] Added a setting for maximum number of players. Choose between 5 and 10. Any players that try to join after that will join as Observers
[/list]

notes.title: NEW UPDATE - QuickPlay mode added, minor bug fixes, & more!
notes.notes:
[b]Changes/Updates to TV Screens[/b]
[list]
[*] The biggest addition in this update includes the new game mode, "Quickplay" which allows users to play a single, 1-round game. Ideal for new groups to learn how to play the game or those who want to try out the game in a quick, simple format.
[*] Updated some font sizes and colors to make them more legible.
[*] Fixed some audio issues with the tutorial video
[*] Fixed some bugs with the "Esc" menu when accessed in the game lobby.
[/list]

[b]Changes/Updates to Phone Screens[/b]
[list]
[*] One of the most common requests we got from play testers so far was the functionality for the game to prohibit/prevent users from entering the same clue more than once, so that's been added in.
[*] In addition, we have added an error message if players attempt to enter a clue that matches the Password.
[*] Adjusted the "how to play" instructions on the phone to include more explanation for players during the deliberation rounds.
[*] Fixed some bugs that caused display issues on larger iphones.
[/list]
